en.hubeali: From him, from one of his companions, raising it, said,
‘Whatever Given to a servant from the world is only as a lesson, and whatever is Delayed from him is only as a Trial’.
en.sarwar: 6. It is narrated from him (narrator of the Hadith above) from certain individuals of his people in a marfu’ manner
who has said the following: “Whatever a servant is given of worldly things is to make him learn a lesson and whatever is withheld from him is to place him under the trial.’”
